AfterShow.Name: Init
AfterShow.Source: (function () {      var self = this;      var slotId = "balance_slot";      var selector = "#" + slotId;      var lastStoppedSignature = null;      function raiseEvent(evtName) {        try {          if (typeof self[evtName] === "function") {            self[evtName]();            return;          }          if (self.Events && typeof self.Events[evtName] === "function") {            self.Events[evtName]();          }        } catch (e) {          console.error("Erro ao disparar evento GX:", evtName, e);        }      }      function loadScriptOnce(src, cb) {        var exists = Array.prototype.some.call(document.scripts, function (s) {          return s.src && s.src.indexOf(src) >= 0;        });        if (exists || window.BalanceWidget) {          cb();          return;        }        var s = document.createElement("script");        s.src = src;        s.async = true;        s.onload = cb;        s.onerror = function () {          console.error("Falha ao carregar script:", src);        };        document.head.appendChild(s);      }      function mountWidget() {        if (!window.BalanceWidget) {          console.error("BalanceWidget não encontrado.");          return;        }        var host = document.querySelector(selector);        if (!host) {          console.error("Slot do widget não encontrado:", selector);          return;        }        var serverUrl = (self.server || "").trim() || window.location.origin;        var deviceId = (self.device_id || "1").toString();        self._bw = window.BalanceWidget.mount(selector, {          serverUrl: serverUrl,          deviceId: deviceId,          title: self.title || "Balança",		  useShadowDom: false,  		  includeDefaultStyles: false        });        self.GetStoppedData = function () {          if (!self._bw || typeof self._bw.getStoppedData !== "function") {            return null;          }          return self._bw.getStoppedData();        };        self._bw.ready          .then(function (api) {            if (!api || !api.socket) {              return;            }            api.socket.on("cmd_ack", function (p) {              if (!p || String(p.device_id) !== String(deviceId) || !p.ok) {                return;              }              if (p.cmd === "zero") {                raiseEvent("zero");              }              if (p.cmd === "tare") {                raiseEvent("tare");              }              if (p.cmd === "cancel_tare") {                raiseEvent("cancel_tare");              }              if (p.cmd === "request_weight") {                raiseEvent("request_weight");              }            });            if (self._stoppedPollTimer) {              clearInterval(self._stoppedPollTimer);              self._stoppedPollTimer = null;            }            self._stoppedPollTimer = setInterval(function () {              if (!self._bw || typeof self._bw.getStoppedData !== "function") {                return;              }              var data = self._bw.getStoppedData();              var reading = data && data.reading;              if (!reading) {                return;              }              var signature =                String(reading.timestamp || "") +                "|" +                String(reading.weight || "");              if (signature === lastStoppedSignature) {                return;              }              lastStoppedSignature = signature;              self.stopped_weight = String(                reading.weight == null ? "" : reading.weight              );              self.stopped_unit = String(reading.unit || "");              self.stopped_raw = String(reading.raw || "");              self.stopped_timestamp = String(reading.timestamp || "");              raiseEvent("weight_stopped");            }, 300);          })          .catch(function (err) {            console.error("Erro ao iniciar widget:", err);          });      }      loadScriptOnce("/balance-widget.js?v=20260722-3", mountWidget);    }).call(this);
